chapter.verse: Sanggamte aw, mi khatpeuh in na khatpeuh palsat cih a kitheih leh kha tawh a kidim note in thudam tawh amah na bawlhoihkik un. No zong siatzolna na thuak loh nadingun noleno na kikem un.
Khatlekhat vangik na kipuakpih unla tua bangin Khris' thukhun na cingsak un.
A hang pen mi khatpeuh, bangmah hilo napi ahidan khatin a kingaihsut leh amahmah a kikhem ahi hi.
Ahih hangin a kuamahpeuh in a sepna uh sittel ciat hen. Tua hileh ama' kisialhna pen amah khat kia hang bek hiding a, a vengte tawh kitehna hang hilo ding hi.
A hang pen mi kim in ama' van tek a puak ding ahi hi.
Pasian' thu tawh pattahna a ngah mite in a pantahte tungah nahoih khempeuh hawmsawn ta hen.
Theikhialkha kei un: Pasian khembawl theih hilo hi. A hang pen mite in a vawh bangbang at ding uh hi.
Ama' cilesa deihna thu a vawhte in cilesa panin muatna at ding uh a, Kha deihna thu a vawhte in Kha panin tawntung nuntakna at ding uh hi.
Tua hi a, nahoih sep ding cimtaak kei ni. A hang pen lungkia lo-in i sep leh a hun a tun ciangin a gah i at ding hi.
Tua ahih manin hunpha i ngah bangin mi khempeuh tungah, leh a diakin upna sunga innkuanpihte tungah, nahoih sem ni.
No tungah keima' khut ngiat tawh laimal hizah-a gol pipite kong gelh en ta un.
Vun-atna na zat ding uh hong thatang sawl nuamte pen cilesa tawh mi' thupitmuh ding a utte hi a, Khris' singlamteh hangin bawlsiat a thuakkhak ding a pelhnop man uh ahi hi.
A hang pen vun-atna a zangte nangawn in thukhun zui lo uh a, nomau' cilesa thu na zuihna uh hangin a kisialhnop manun vun-atte hong suaksak nuam uh ahi hi.

Ahi zongin kei ka hihleh i Topa Jesu Khris' singlamteh thu longal thudang khatpeuh ka kisialhpih ngeikei ding hi. Tua singlamteh hangin leitung cih pen kei' ading a kikhailum khin hi a, kei zong leitung thu ah tua mah bang ka hi hi.
A hang pen vun-atna ahi-a vun-atlohna ahi zongin a thupi om lo a, piansakna thak bek a thupi ahi hi.
Tua hi a, hih thupaizia a zui mite khempeuh tawh kisai-in amaute' tung leh Pasian' minam Israel mite' tungah nopna lemna leh thukhualna om ta hen.
Tu-a kipanin kuamah in kei hong nawngkaisak kei ta hen. A hang pen ka pumpi tungah Jesu' mapawnte ka pua hi.
Sanggamte aw, i Topa Jesu Khris' hehpihna in na kha uh hong ompih ta hen. Amen.
